ElvUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|LOGIN_MSG: "Welcome to %sElvUI|r version %s%s|r, type /ec to access the in-game configuration menu. If you are in need of technical support you can visit us at https://github.com/ElvUI-WotLK/ElvUI or join our Discord: https://discord.gg/UXSc7nt"

"You are going to copy settings for "

ElvUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|You still have: "You still have ElvUI_Config installed. ElvUI_Config has been renamed to ElvUI_OptionsUI, please remove it."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Add: "Add a spell to the filter. Use spell ID if you don't want to match all auras which share the same name."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Allo: "Allow LBF to handle the skinning of this element."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Alph: "Alpha channel is taken from the color option."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|An X: "An X offset (in pixels) to be used when anchoring new frames."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|An Y: "An Y offset (in pixels) to be used when anchoring new frames."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Appl: "Applies the font and font size settings throughout the entire user interface. Note: Some font size settings will be skipped due to them having a smaller font size by default."
"Applies the primary texture to all statusbars."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Auto: "Automatically hide the objetive frame during boss or arena fights."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Bloc: "Blocks all click events while in combat."
"Blocks datatext tooltip from showing in combat."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Chan: "Change the width and controls how big of an area on the screen will accept clicks to target unit."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Chec: "Check these to only have the filter active in certain difficulties. If none are checked, it is active in all difficulties."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Choo: "Choose UIPARENT to prevent it from hiding with the unitframe."
"Choose when you want the tooltip to show in combat. If a modifer is chosen, then you need to hold that down to show the tooltip."
"Choose when you want the tooltip to show. If a modifer is chosen, then you need to hold that down to show the tooltip."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Colo: "Color Keybind Text when Out of Range, instead of the button."
"Color castbars by the class of player units."
"Color castbars by the reaction type of non-player units."
"Color of the actionbutton when not usable."
"Colors the border according to the Quality of the Item."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Cont: "Control enemy nameplates toggling on or off when in combat."
"Control friendly nameplates toggling on or off when in combat."
"Controls how big of an area on the screen will accept clicks to target unit."
"Controls the amount of decimals used in values displayed on elements like NamePlates and UnitFrames."
"Controls the speed at which smoothed bars will be updated."
"Controls how many seconds of inactivity has to pass before chat is faded."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Disa: "Disables the focus and target of focus unitframes."
"Disables the target and target of target unitframes."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Disp: "Display an exclamation mark on items that starts a quest."
"Display battleground messages in the middle of the screen."
"Display the castbar icon inside the castbar."
"Display the castbar inside the information panel, the icon will be displayed outside the main unitframe."
"Display the junk icon on all grey items that can be vendored."
"Display the name of the unit on the chat bubble."
"Display the npc ID when mousing over a npc tooltip."
"Displays a detailed report of every item sold when enabled."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Don': "Don't display auras that are longer than this duration (in seconds). Set to zero to disable."
"Don't display auras that are shorter than this duration (in seconds). Set to zero to disable."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Enab: "Enable the use of separate size options for the right chat panel."
"Enabling this allows raid-wide sorting however you will not be able to distinguish between groups."
"Enabling this inverts the grouping order when the raid is not full, this will reverse the direction it starts from."
"Enabling this will check your health amount."
"Enabling this will check your power amount."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Erro: "Error decoding data. Import string may be corrupted!"
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Excl: "Excluded names will not be class colored."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Fade: "Fades the buttons that toggle chat windows when that window has been toggled off."
"Fades the text on chat tabs that are docked in a panel where the backdrop is disabled."
"Fades the text on chat tabs that are not docked at the left or right chat panel."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Filt: "Filters are not allowed to have commas in their name. Stripping commas from filter name."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Forc: "Forces Debuff Highlight to be disabled for these frames"
"Forces Mouseover Glow to be disabled for these frames"
"Forces Target Glow to be disabled for these frames"
"Forces reaction color instead of class color on units controlled by players."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Heig: "Height of the objective tracker. Increase size to be able to see more objectives."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Here: "Here you can add items or search terms that you want to be excluded from sorting. To remove an item just click on its name in the list."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Hide: "Hide specific sections in the datatext tooltip."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|How: "How long the cutaway health will take to fade out."
"How long the cutaway power will take to fade out."
"How many seconds the castbar should stay visible after the cast failed or was interrupted."
"How much time before the cutaway health starts to fade."
"How much time before the cutaway power starts to fade."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|If e: "If enabled then it checks if auras are missing instead of being present on the unit."
"If enabled then it will require all auras to activate the filter. Otherwise it will only require any one of the auras to activate it."
"If enabled then it will require all cooldowns to activate the filter. Otherwise it will only require any one of the cooldowns to activate it."
"If enabled then the filter will activate if the unit is casting anything."
"If enabled then the filter will activate if the unit is channeling anything."
"If enabled then the filter will activate if the unit is not casting anything."
"If enabled then the filter will activate if the unit is not channeling anything."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate if the level of the unit is equal to or higher than this value."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate if the level of the unit is equal to or lower than this value."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate if the level of the unit matches this value."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate if the level of the unit matches your own."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate if the unit is casting interruptible spells."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate if the unit is casting not interruptible spells."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate if the unit is not casting or channeling one of the selected spells."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate when you are in combat."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate when you are not targeting the unit."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate when you are out of combat."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate when you are resting at an Inn."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate when you are targeting the unit."
"If enabled then the filter will only activate when you have a target."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|If t: "If the aura is listed with a number then you need to use that to remove it from the list."
"If this list is empty, and if 'Interruptible' is checked, then the filter will activate on any type of cast that can be interrupted."
"If this threshold is used then the health of the unit needs to be higher than this value in order for the filter to activate. Set to 0 to disable."
"If this threshold is used then the health of the unit needs to be lower than this value in order for the filter to activate. Set to 0 to disable."
"If this threshold is used then the power of the unit needs to be higher than this value in order for the filter to activate. Set to 0 to disable."
"If this threshold is used then the power of the unit needs to be lower than this value in order for the filter to activate. Set to 0 to disable."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|If y: "If you have a lot of 3D Portraits active then it will likely have a big impact on your FPS. Disable some portraits if you experience FPS issues."
"If you have any plugins supporting this feature installed you can find them in the selection dropdown to the right."
"If you unlock actionbars then trying to move a spell might instantly cast it if you cast spells on key press instead of key release."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Inhe: "Inherit the global fade, mousing over, targetting, setting focus, losing health, entering combat will set the remove transparency. Otherwise it will use the transparency level in the general actionbar settings for global fade alpha."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|LEVE: "Set level to -1 for boss units or set to 0 to disable."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Lowe: "Lower numbers mean a higher priority. Filters are processed in order from 1 to 100."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Make: "Make the unitframe glow yellow when it is below this percent of health, it will glow red when the health value is half of this value."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Max: "Max amount of overflow allowed to extend past the end of the health bar."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Numb: "Number of messages you scroll for each step."
"Number of repeat characters while in combat before the chat editbox is automatically closed. Set to 0 to disable."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Only: "Only show when the unit is not in range."
"Only show when you are mousing over a frame."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Remo: "Remove a spell from the filter. Use the spell ID if you see the ID as part of the spell name in the filter."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Repl: "Replaces the default Blizzard fonts on various panels and frames with the fonts chosen in the Media section of the ElvUI Options. NOTE: Any font that inherits from the fonts ElvUI usually replaces will be affected as well if you disable this. Enabled by default."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Requ: "Require holding the Alt key down to move cursor or cycle through messages in the editbox."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Rese: "Reset filter priority to the default state."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Reve: "Reverse Toggle will enable Cooldown Text on this module when the global setting is disabled and disable them when the global setting is enabled."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Scal: "Scale of the nameplate that is targetted."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Sear: "Search for a spell name inside of a filter."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Seco: "Seconds remaining on the aura duration before the bar starts moving. Set to 0 to disable."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Set: "Set the alpha level of portrait when frame is overlayed."
"Set the filter type. Blacklist will hide any auras in the list and show all others. Whitelist will show any auras in the filter and hide all others."
"Set to either stack nameplates vertically or allow them to overlap."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Shou: "Should tooltip be anchored to mouse cursor"
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Show: "Show the castbar icon desaturated if a spell is not interruptible."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|The: "The Portrait will overlay the Healthbar. This will be automatically happen if the Frame Orientation is set to Middle."
"The Thin Border Theme option will change the overall apperance of your UI. Using Thin Border Theme is a slight performance increase over the traditional layout."
"The debuff needs to reach this amount of stacks before it is shown. Set to 0 to always show the debuff."
"The direction the auras will grow and then the direction they will grow after they reach the wrap after limit."
"The display format of the money text that is shown at the top of the main bag."
"The display format of the money text that is shown in the gold datatext and its tooltip."
"The minimum item level required for it to be shown."
"The unit prefixes you want to use when values are shortened in ElvUI. This is mostly used on UnitFrames."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Thes: "These filters don't use a list of spells like the regular filters. Instead they use the WoW API and some code logic to determine if an aura should be allowed or blocked."
"These filters use a list of spells to determine if an aura should be allowed or blocked. The content of these filters can be modified in the 'Filters' section of the config."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|This: "This dictates the size of the icon when it is not attached to the castbar."
"This is for Customized Icons in your Interface/Icons folder."
"This opens the UnitFrames Color settings. These settings affect all unitframes."
"This option allows the overlay to span the whole health, including the background."
"This section will allow you to copy settings to a select module from or to a different profile."
"This section will help reset specfic settings back to default."
"This selects the Chat Frame to use as the output of ElvUI messages."
"This setting controls the size of text in item comparison tooltips."
"This setting will be updated upon changing stances."
"This will override the global cooldown settings."
"This will prevent the UI Scale Popup from being shown when changing the game window size."
"This will reset the contents of this filter back to default. Any spell you have added to this filter will be removed."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Thre: "Threshold (in minutes) before text is shown in the HH:MM format. Set to -1 to never change to this format."
"Threshold (in seconds) before text is shown in the MM:SS format. Set to -1 to never change to this format."

ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Tran: "Transparency level when not in combat, no target exists, full health, not casting, and no focus target exists."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Use: "Use Shift+LeftClick to toggle between friendly or enemy or normal state. Normal state will allow the filter to be checked on all units. Friendly state is for friendly units only and enemy state is for enemy units."
"Use class color for the names of players when they are mentioned."
"Use coin icons instead of colored text."
"Use drag and drop to rearrange filter priority or right click to remove a filter."
"Use the Name Color of the unit for the Name Glow."
"Use the custom backdrop color instead of a multiple of the main color."
"Use the profile specific filter 'Buff Indicator (Profile)' instead of the global filter 'Buff Indicator'."
"Use thin borders on certain unitframe elements."
"Use this backdrop color for units that are dead or ghosts."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|When: "When enabled active buff icons will light up instead of becoming darker, while inactive buff icons will become darker instead of being lit up."
"When enabled it will only show spells that were added to the filter using a spell ID and not a name."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|Will: "Will attempt to sell another item in set interval after previous one was sold."
"Will show Buffs in the Debuff position when there are no Debuffs active, or vice versa."
ElvUI_OptionsUI/Locales/enUS.lua#|L|You: "You do not need to use 'Is Casting Anything' or 'Is Channeling Anything' for these spells to trigger."
"You need to hold this modifier down in order to blacklist an aura by right-clicking the icon. Set to None to disable the blacklist functionality."
